gate: A document is kept when an RWE term sits in a passage about a study or a judgement. Checkbox text, nonclinical historical controls, contents pages, and bibliography lines are not kept.

ema.method: Human medicines with a marketing authorisation from 1 January 2026 through 24 October 2026. Latest matched assessment report.

fda.method: FDA novel drug approvals for 2026 with an approval date on or before 24 October 2026. Integrated, medical, or statistical review when posted on Drugs@FDA.
